title: Local Individual & Family Counseling Resources
author: FBC Muncie
excerpt: While experiences can and will vary, the following practitioners come with positive recommendations.  Each organization is different...
bodyHtml:
Each organization is different, and sometimes it can take some work to find the right practitioner for individual or family counseling. While experiences can and will vary, the following practitioners come with positive recommendations. 

Check practitioner websites for specialties.



This resource list was created for the Summer 2024 series "Kingdom Family Vacation."


 


□  Attuned LIfe Counseling

Address: 114 E Washington St Muncie, IN 47305

Contact: Contact Form Online; Secure Fax: (765) 881 - 7519; johanna@attunedlifecc.com


□ Center for Psychological Development

Address: 2205 North Wheeling Avenue Muncie, IN 47303

Recommended Practitioners: Melissa Osner, LMHC & Joel Chandler, LMHC

To seek an appointment: Call (765) 287-1922, email: cpd526@gmail.com, or fill out their online form at muncietherapy.com


□  Freedom Work Counseling & Consulting

Address: 114 E. Washington St. Muncie, IN 47305

Recommended Practitioners: Christina Smith, MA, LMHC & David Smith, MA, LMHC

To seek an appointment:  For information see: https://freedomworkcc.com, email admin@freedomworkcc.com, or call (765)-273-3224


□  Open Door Health Services

Address: 333 S Madison St, Muncie, IN 47305

Recommended Practitioners: Nicholas Lee, PhD, HSPP

To seek an appointment: call (765) 286-7000 M-F from 8 a.m.-5 p.m., or fill out their online form at opendoorhs.org/appointments.


□  Still Waters Professional Counseling

Address: 333 S Madison St, Muncie, IN 47305

Contact: 3301 W Purdue Avenue Muncie, IN 47304, (765) 284-0043; admin@stillwaterspc.com; stillwaterspc.com 




 
Other Support

□ Grief share (support for those who have experienced a loss): griefshare.org

 Most immediate local group meets Jun 5, 2024 – Aug 28, 2024, Wednesdays 6:30 PM @ First Church of the Nazarene - 3101 N Benton Rd Muncie, IN


□ A Better Way (Domestic and Sexual Abuse Response) / Muncie office: 765-747-9107. Legal, emotional, housing support: https://abetterwaymuncie.org/our-services/
